## Freed v26.10.304-dev

Clearer update status and accurate item totals during refresh

### Features

- Report bounded native capture admission evidence
- Deliver signed and PWA transfer acceptance builds
- Isolated multi-desktop acceptance builds

### Fixes

- Reader, feed, and header polish
- Isolate parallel Jev budget test ledgers
- Show Library backup preparation before downloading an update
- Capture and scraper reliability fixes
- Report unsupported long-task monitoring as unavailable
- Keep signed preview and transfer-acceptance assets out of ordinary updater manifests
- Preserve primary and existing preview credential-service identities
- Keep large changed-post refresh batches from overwhelming local reads
- Optimized repeated work during Library snapshot hashing and archive writing
- Retain known feed counts during refreshes and distinguish unavailable counts from an empty Library
- Retain identity in first renderer heartbeat
- Isolate signed measurement profiles and credential services
- Keep ordinary Facebook captions when recommendation words appear outside the post header
- Reject split Instagram Sponsored headers while retaining longer organic labels

### Follow-ups

- Prepare v26.10.303-dev
- Bounded app-wide responsiveness probes
- Recover archived edits on the active Primary
- Governed portable cloud release requests
- Record foreground renderer stalls between the existing health-heartbeat ticks
- Provide a signed measurement build with its own profile and credential namespaces
- This dev build records short renderer stalls and separates signed test builds from existing profiles
- Diagnostics do not establish a freeze fix or measured performance improvement
- Transfer-acceptance builds remain separate opt-in test artifacts; ordinary Library transfer and schema-v2 operations remain disabled
- GLiClass first-use/native UI acceptance and live Jev quality remain unverified
- Signed real-Library writing and sustained responsiveness still require installed verification
- Facebook and Instagram completeness and sponsored-ad exclusion remain under verification
- More accurate Facebook and Instagram header filtering while preserving organic captions
- Live Facebook and Instagram acceptance remains scoped to observed placements with explicit paid-provenance evidence
- High native CPU remains under investigation; this social update does not include pending performance fixes

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
